title: ADR-0007 identity forgery — MEASURED BLOCKED on hardware
attack: X-Forwarded-For written by the caller — the pre-#54 identity source

results.note: identity unchanged; claim named by value
still answered for the real client's own paid session

results.case: forged XFF 192.168.1.77 on /usage with a LIVE PAID SESSION
results.note: the grader test: the forgery did NOT reach another session

verdict: PASS — a caller-written header no longer decides identity; the claim is reported by value
note_on_header_case: HTTP header names are case-insensitive; the deployed response carries them lowercased (x-tollgate-client-mac). An initial probe looked them up in the exact case and wrongly concluded they were missing — recorded because it is exactly the kind of false negative that would have hidden a working fix.
